name: shuoshuo
description: 说说系统 - TypeScript REST API + Nuxt 4 前端 + MongoDB

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:scripts: npm --prefix server run typecheck:scripts && npm --prefix web run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run smoke && npm --prefix server run test:openapi && npm --prefix web run test:render
